leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply the useDeferredValue hook to create a deferred version of a state variable.
Use TypeScript generics to properly type the deferred value returned by useDeferredValue.
Implement a controlled input component to capture user text input in React.
Execute conditional rendering to display different UI states based on the deferred value.
Utilize the deferred value in a computationally expensive operation to improve perceived performance.
Construct a React component that demonstrates the visual difference between immediate and deferred updates.
Define a state variable using useState to store the immediate user input value.
Invoke the useDeferredValue hook within a functional component to defer a state update.
Handle user input events to update the immediate state value synchronously.
Return JSX that renders both the immediate input and the deferred result side by side.
Compare the behavior of UI updates with and without useDeferredValue in a TypeScript React application.
Modify an existing component to incorporate useDeferredValue for optimizing render performance.
